header: Using the AWS SDKs to interact with Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
content:
This section includes examples of how to use the AWS SDKs to interact with Amazon OpenSearch
Serverless. These code samples show how to create security policies and collections, and how to
query collections.
Note
We're currently building out these code samples. If you want to contribute a code sample
(Java, Go, etc.), please open a pull request directly within the GitHub repository.
